items.description: Map repository modules, interfaces, and data flow
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/planning/repo_module_map.md` that documents every non-vendor module (`TASK_orchestrator.md`, `.archivara/concept_evolve.py`, `.archivara/semantic_scholar.py`, `.opencode/tools/*.ts`, `.opencode/agents/*.md`, `results/`, `figures/`) with purpose, inputs, outputs, and at least 8 explicit dependency edges.

items.description: Formalize target theorem, constraints, and success definition
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/planning/problem_spec.md` with rigorous definitions of `B_u`, `B_f`, normalization assumptions, known bound chain `B <= B_l <= L <= B_u`, and a concrete target criterion: certify a lower bound strictly greater than 0.5708858 with explicit numeric margin and proof obligations.

items.description: Conduct web-based landscape search for papers, code, and methods
items.acceptance_criteria: Run structured web searches and save `results/literature/web_search_log.json` containing at least 30 unique hits spanning papers, preprints, and code repositories relevant to Bloch/Landau constants, univalent function extremal problems, Loewner methods, and rigorous numerics; include query strings and retrieval timestamps.

items.description: Create and maintain canonical bibliography in `sources.bib`
items.acceptance_criteria: Add root-level `sources.bib` with BibTeX entries for all consulted sources, including Skinner (2009), Yanagihara (1995), Bhowmik-Sen (2023), and at least 7 additional relevant works (>=10 total); each entry must include year and at least one persistent identifier (DOI/arXiv/URL).

items.description: Delegate literature exploration and synthesis to subagents
items.acceptance_criteria: Execute one exploration delegation (e.g., `literature-graph-miner` or `explore`) and one synthesis delegation (e.g., `general`), then produce `results/literature/gap_matrix.json` with at least 5 ranked unresolved gaps, 5 transferable techniques, and citations mapped to `sources.bib` keys.

items.description: Define reproducible baseline execution protocol
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/baseline/run_manifest.json` capturing environment details, deterministic seeds, numeric precision settings, and command entrypoints so a fresh researcher can replay baseline runs end-to-end without ambiguity.

items.description: Reproduce the best published lower bound as baseline
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce `results/baseline/replication_report.md` that independently reconstructs the 0.5708858 lower-bound benchmark (or nearest reproducible surrogate) with documented assumptions, numerical tolerances, and at least one independent cross-check path.

items.description: Establish quantitative metrics and gating thresholds
items.acceptance_criteria: Publish `results/baseline/metrics_spec.json` defining at minimum `certified_lower_bound`, `delta_vs_0_5708858`, `certificate_verification_time_sec`, and `numerical_residual_max`; include pass/fail thresholds and reporting format for all later phases.

items.description: Generate concept-tree workspace and dependency graph
items.acceptance_criteria: Run concept-tree expansion and ensure `results/concept_evolve/tree/` contains at least 14 concept folders plus `index.json`, `adjacency.json`, and `walk_paths.json`; add `results/concept_evolve/tree/dependency_dag.json` with at least 20 directed dependencies between concept modules.

items.description: Delegate baseline failure-mode audit and synthesis
items.acceptance_criteria: Use one exploration subagent to inspect baseline bottlenecks and one synthesis subagent to consolidate actions, then save `results/baseline/subagent_audit.md` with at least 10 prioritized fixes tied directly to `metrics_spec.json` thresholds.

items.description: Develop Loewner-control extremal candidate program
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/novel/loewner_program.md` specifying control parametrization, admissible function class, rigorous objective lower-bounding strategy, and at least 3 falsifiable hypotheses for improving the current 0.5708858 bound.

items.description: Formulate coefficient-body relaxation with certified truncation error
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/novel/coefficient_relaxation.md` containing a finite-dimensional optimization model (target truncation order >= 12), explicit remainder/error control arguments, and a validation checklist connecting assumptions to univalent-class constraints.

items.description: Design hybrid rigorous-numerics search for tighter certificates
items.acceptance_criteria: Publish `results/novel/rigorous_search_design.md` with interval arithmetic strategy, branch-and-bound decomposition, certificate format, and compute budget plan; include at least 2 independent verification routes for any claimed bound improvement.

items.description: Traverse high-value concept paths from concept tree
items.acceptance_criteria: Use `results/concept_evolve/tree/walk_paths.json` to select at least 5 distinct root-to-leaf concept paths; for each path create an experiment card under `results/novel/path_cards/` with objective, dependency list, and measurable success signal.

items.description: Delegate novelty mining and synthesis across domains
items.acceptance_criteria: Run one exploration delegation (concept-tree or citation mining) and one synthesis delegation, then output `results/novel/strategy_shortlist.json` with at least 3 novel candidate approaches, each scored by expected bound lift, rigor risk, and implementation effort.

items.description: Build experiment matrix with explicit method-parameter coverage
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/experiments/experiment_matrix.json` defining at least 12 runs across at least 3 method families and 4 parameter regimes, with each run linked to a Phase 3 path card and required certificate artifacts.

items.description: Execute bound-search runs and generate certificates
items.acceptance_criteria: Populate `results/experiments/runs/` with per-run logs, numeric outputs, and machine-checkable certificates; produce `results/experiments/best_bound.json` reporting the strongest certified lower bound and whether it strictly exceeds 0.5708858.

items.description: Benchmark outcomes against prior literature
items.acceptance_criteria: Generate `results/experiments/literature_comparison.md` that compares current results against Skinner (2009), Yanagihara (1995), Bhowmik-Sen (2023), and at least 3 additional sources from `sources.bib`, with numeric deltas and method-level differences.

items.description: Run ablations and robustness checks on best candidates
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/experiments/robustness_report.md` summarizing at least 5 ablations (precision, discretization, initialization, search depth, and validation method) and quantify stability of the certified lower bound under each perturbation.

items.description: Delegate anomaly triage and evaluation synthesis
items.acceptance_criteria: Use an exploration subagent to detect anomalous/contradictory runs and a synthesis subagent to resolve interpretation, then save `results/experiments/subagent_triage.md` with at least 5 anomalies, root-cause hypotheses, and disposition decisions.

items.description: Assemble proof and certificate dossier for best bound
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce `results/final/proof_dossier.md` that links theorem statements, computational lemmas, and certificate files needed to verify the best bound claim end-to-end without hidden steps.

items.description: Explain causal drivers of bound improvement or failure
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/final/causal_analysis.md` attributing performance changes to specific methodological choices, including at least 3 evidence-backed causal claims and 3 discarded hypotheses.

items.description: Close concept-tree loop with promotion, pruning, and next-cycle plan
items.acceptance_criteria: Update `results/concept_evolve/tree/index.json` (or companion `results/concept_evolve/tree/final_status.json`) to label each explored concept as promoted, deferred, or pruned; include explicit dependency rationale and next-step owner for every promoted concept.

items.description: Delegate independent replication review and narrative synthesis
items.acceptance_criteria: Run one exploration-style independent review delegation and one synthesis delegation, then publish `results/final/replication_review.md` with reproducibility verdict, discrepancy log, and resolution status for every critical issue.

items.description: Deliver final research report and artifact index
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/final/final_report.md` plus `results/final/artifact_index.json` summarizing best certified bound, comparison to 0.5708858, relation to cited prior work, limitations, and concrete next experiments; report must cite at least 10 entries from `sources.bib`.
